reference: S. Mumtaz, R.-J. Essiambre, G. P. Agrawal, 'Nonlinear Propagation in Multimode and Multicore Fibers', J. Lightwave Technol. 31, 398 (2013), doi:10.1109/JLT.2012.2235414

fiber.type: step-index MMF (section IV); degenerate-pair XPM check uses the idealized isotropic overlap f=1 (paper section V GRIN context: f_11ab=0.3, f_21ab=1)
fiber.loss_note: paper has 0.2 dB/km with EDFA compensation; field-level checks use lossless spans

dispersion_table_II.beta2_conversion: beta2 = -lambda^2 D / (2 pi c); D=25 ps/(nm km) -> -31.9 ps^2/km at 1550 nm

signal.paper_signal: 114 Gb/s PDM-QPSK, 28.5 Gbaud, roll-off 0.2, 2^15 symbols, 7 dBm per spatial mode (paper section IV)
signal.field_level_stand_in: Gaussian pulses, FWHM 100 ps, 7 dBm (5 mW) peak-relevant power per spatial mode; BER/DSP layer out of scope (planned-README decision)

manakov_equation_29.inter_mode_xpm_coefficient: 4/3 (degenerate modes, reduced from 2; paper section V/VI)
manakov_equation_29.note: paper: Manakov needs far larger steps than Eq. 12 (Table III logic)

stochastic_equation_12.rotation: independent Haar SU(2) Jones matrix per spatial mode per segment (paper Eqs. 9-11 + procedure [26]: QR of complex Ginibre)
stochastic_equation_12.segment_frame_nonlinearity: full Mumtaz Eq. 6 cubic: SPM 1, XPM 2/3, coherent (A_l^T A_m)A_n* terms 1/3 (Agrawal 6.1 vector structure)

checks.1_table_II_walkoff: centroid separations over 100 km = DMGD x L (LP01/LP11: 0.65 us, LP01/LP21: 1.2 us)
checks.2_spm_8_9: ensemble-averaged stochastic spectra vs engine xpm_weights=8/9 run, rel L2 < 5%
checks.3_manakov_m2: M=2 degenerate ensemble vs engine 8/9 + 4/3 run, rel L2 < 5%; no-birefringence reference shown for contrast
